name: taekwondo-journey
description: Offline taekwondo training game for kids (PWA, Arabic/English).

scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:android: npm run build && npx cap add android && npx cap sync android
scripts.cap:ios: npm run build && npx cap add ios && npx cap sync ios
scripts.rig: python3 tools/rig/build-rig.py tools/rig/boy.rig.json && python3 tools/rig/build-rig.py tools/rig/girl.rig.json
